    md.quote_depth_snapshot->'depth'->>'biddepth' AS bid_depth,

FROM
    orders AS o

    SELECT
        (quote_depth_snapshot->'metadata'->>'mktcombo')::varchar AS mktcombo,

    o.mktnote = md.mktcombo AND md.rn = 1;

WITH MarketMood AS (
    SELECT 
        m.marketdatanode,
        m.quote_depth_snapshot#>'{metadata, mktcombo}' AS market_pair,
        (m.quote_depth_snapshot#>'{spread, spreadrate}')::float AS spread_percentage,
        a.market_sentiment_indicators#>'{momentum, mktfeel}' AS overall_market_mood,
        (a.market_sentiment_indicators#>'{momentum, buyforce}')::float AS buy_force
    FROM 
        marketdata AS m
    JOIN 
        analyticsindicators AS a ON m.marketdatanode = a.mdataref
),
MoodAvgSpread AS (
    SELECT 
        overall_market_mood, 
        AVG(spread_percentage) AS avg_spread_percentage
    FROM 
        MarketMood
    GROUP BY 
        overall_market_mood
),
PercentileRank AS (
    SELECT 
        marketdatanode,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY spread_percentage) AS percentile_rank
    FROM 
        MarketMood
)
SELECT 
    mm.market_pair,
    mm.spread_percentage,
    mm.overall_market_mood,
    mm.buy_force,
    mas.avg_spread_percentage,
    pr.percentile_rank
FROM 
    MarketMood AS mm
LEFT JOIN 
    MoodAvgSpread AS mas ON mm.overall_market_mood = mas.overall_market_mood
LEFT JOIN 
    PercentileRank AS pr ON mm.marketdatanode = pr.marketdatanode;

08f7e5ce3fe2ccf2336b1da104ff9e1def8ba8e7.sql:
WITH TopPositions AS (
    SELECT 
        rm.riskandmarginpivot, 
        o.notionsum AS notional_value, 
        ms.volmeter AS volatility_measure, 
        CAST(rm.risk_margin_profile->>'inithold' AS NUMERIC) AS initial_margin, 
        CAST(rm.risk_margin_profile->>'mainthold' AS NUMERIC) AS maintenance_margin, 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY o.notionsum DESC) AS position_rank
    FROM 
        riskandmargin rm
    JOIN 
        orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
    JOIN 
        marketstats ms ON rm.riskandmarginpivot = ms.marketstatsmark
    WHERE 
        rm.risk_margin_profile->>'possum' IS NOT NULL 
        AND o.notionsum IS NOT NULL 
        AND ms.volmeter IS NOT NULL
),
PVaRCalculation AS (
    SELECT 
        riskandmarginpivot, 
        notional_value, 
        volatility_measure, 
        initial_margin, 
        maintenance_margin, 
        (
            (notional_value * volatility_measure) - 
            (initial_margin + maintenance_margin)
        ) AS pvar
    FROM 
        TopPositions
    WHERE 
        position_rank <= 5
)
SELECT 
    pvar AS risk_and_margin_pivot, 
    notional_value, 
    volatility_measure, 
    pvar AS calculated_pvar
FROM 
    PVaRCalculation;

WITH smart_trades AS (
    SELECT 
        (market_sentiment_indicators->'flow'->>'smartforce')::FLOAT AS smartforce
    FROM 
        analyticsindicators
),
successful_smart_trades AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE smartforce > 0) AS successful_trades_count,
        COUNT(*) AS total_trades_count
    FROM 
        smart_trades
)
SELECT 
    successful_trades_count / total_trades_count AS success_rate
FROM 
    successful_smart_trades;
